evidence: Changes transaction and witness primitives in src/script/ and src/primitives/transaction.h, dramatically cutting memory and CPU overhead in block deserialization.
rationale: Eliminates a severe validation-time memory bloat and deserialization DoS vector reported by researchers. Description benchmarks show worst-case block deserialization time drops from 279 ms to 19 ms, persisted block memory from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB, and peak memory from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB.
